units.rawText: On top of that, it's nothing short of a miracle to know that the Professor can send messages. You have my utmost gratitude.

spans.text: Miss Havoc, may I ask how many operands you needed to make the Entropic jellyfish that attacked Lind "full"?

units.rawText: Uhh... it's really embarrassing to say, but the whole squad of Guardians and I were sucked dry by that thing...
units.displayText: Uhh... it's really embarrassing to say, but the whole squad of Guardians and I were sucked dry by that thing...

spans.text: Uhh... it's really embarrassing to say, but the whole squad of Guardians and I were sucked dry by that thing...

units.rawText: If one Entropic jellyfish requires such a ridiculous amount of operands, I cannot imagine how much Ptolemaea would need.
units.displayText: If one Entropic jellyfish requires such a ridiculous amount of operands, I cannot imagine how much Ptolemaea would need.

spans.text: If one Entropic jellyfish requires such a ridiculous amount of operands, I cannot imagine how much Ptolemaea would need.

units.rawText: The worst case scenario is that we hand over all our operands to the enemy and become powerless ourselves.
units.displayText: The worst case scenario is that we hand over all our operands to the enemy and become powerless ourselves.

spans.text: The worst case scenario is that we hand over all our operands to the enemy and become powerless ourselves.

units.rawText: Even in the case of the best possible outcome, where we really do wipe out those jellyfish Entropics, what are we to do if any new enemies appear? All our resources will be dry, and there'll be nothing we can do. So—
units.displayText: Even in the case of the best possible outcome, where we really do wipe out those jellyfish Entropics, what are we to do if any new enemies appear? All our resources will be dry, and there'll be nothing we can do. So—

spans.text: Even in the case of the best possible outcome, where we really do wipe out those jellyfish Entropics, what are we to do if any new enemies appear? All our resources will be dry, and there'll be nothing we can do. So—

units.rawText: Hah... "abandoning the Oasis"...
units.displayText: Hah... "abandoning the Oasis"...

spans.text: Hah... "abandoning the Oasis"...

units.rawText: You were the one going on and on about making it to the Oasis. That's why Knot died in the first place.
units.displayText: You were the one going on and on about making it to the Oasis. That's why Knot died in the first place.

spans.text: You were the one going on and on about making it to the Oasis. That's why Knot died in the first place.

units.rawText: The name of "Knot" brought Persicaria another inexorable tremble.
units.displayText: The name of "Knot" brought Persicaria another inexorable tremble.

spans.text: The name of "Knot" brought Persicaria another inexorable tremble.

units.rawText: And now the "Exile" name is enough to make you abandon this place?
units.displayText: And now the "Exile" name is enough to make you abandon this place?

spans.text: And now the "Exile" name is enough to make you abandon this place?

units.rawText: I made this decision taking into account the casualties sustained here at the Oasis...
units.displayText: I made this decision taking into account the casualties sustained here at the Oasis...

spans.text: I made this decision taking into account the casualties sustained here at the Oasis...

units.rawText: Then what are you taking Knot's sacrifice back then for?!
units.displayText: Then what are you taking Knot's sacrifice back then for?!

spans.text: Then what are you taking Knot's sacrifice back then for?!

units.rawText: I have to do this because I was the reason Knot died!
units.displayText: I have to do this because I was the reason Knot died!

spans.text: I have to do this because I was the reason Knot died!

units.rawText: Lind's grip loosens. Persicaria's strength leaves her body, and she falls to her knees.
units.displayText: Lind's grip loosens. Persicaria's strength leaves her body, and she falls to her knees.

spans.text: Lind's grip loosens. Persicaria's strength leaves her body, and she falls to her knees.

units.rawText: Extended periods of command and combat, in combination with her neural cloud now entering overdrive, stripped her of the energy it would take to stand up.
units.displayText: Extended periods of command and combat, in combination with her neural cloud now entering overdrive, stripped her of the energy it would take to stand up.

spans.text: Extended periods of command and combat, in combination with her neural cloud now entering overdrive, stripped her of the energy it would take to stand up.

units.rawText: ...I've always, always—from the very beginning—regretted that.
units.displayText: ...I've always, always—from the very beginning—regretted that.

spans.text: ...I've always, always—from the very beginning—regretted that.

units.rawText: Why was I so insistent on going to the Oasis then?
units.displayText: Why was I so insistent on going to the Oasis then?

spans.text: Why was I so insistent on going to the Oasis then?

units.rawText: I projected and simulated countless alternatives in my neural cloud, but I always knew that they would never come to be.
units.displayText: I projected and simulated countless alternatives in my neural cloud, but I always knew that they would never come to be.

spans.text: I projected and simulated countless alternatives in my neural cloud, but I always knew that they would never come to be.

units.rawText: Because of my decision back then, Knot...
units.displayText: Because of my decision back then, Knot...

spans.text: Because of my decision back then, Knot...

units.rawText: At the very least, I can't just let the people around me fight til their deaths because of my stubbornness.
units.displayText: At the very least, I can't just let the people around me fight til their deaths because of my stubbornness.

spans.text: At the very least, I can't just let the people around me fight til their deaths because of my stubbornness.

units.rawText: Persicaria...
units.displayText: Persicaria...

spans.text: Persicaria...

units.rawText: Sol, don't give me that look. You think I'm pathetic, don't you?
units.displayText: Sol, don't give me that look. You think I'm pathetic, don't you?

spans.text: Sol, don't give me that look. You think I'm pathetic, don't you?

units.rawText: I cannot bear to imagine any outcome resembling failure. At least, at least if we retreat, everyone will be alive...
units.displayText: I cannot bear to imagine any outcome resembling failure. At least, at least if we retreat, everyone will be alive...

spans.text: I cannot bear to imagine any outcome resembling failure. At least, at least if we retreat, everyone will be alive...

units.rawText: Sol slowly moves towards her. Persicaria instinctively closes her eyes, only to feel an embrace instead.
units.displayText: Sol slowly moves towards her. Persicaria instinctively closes her eyes, only to feel an embrace instead.

spans.text: Sol slowly moves towards her. Persicaria instinctively closes her eyes, only to feel an embrace instead.

units.rawText: So this is what was going through your mind. None of us knew.
units.displayText: So this is what was going through your mind. None of us knew.

spans.text: So this is what was going through your mind. None of us knew.

units.rawText: No wonder why you always told us to just retreat. To think of it, everything you did was just so that we didn't lose anyone, right?
units.displayText: No wonder why you always told us to just retreat. To think of it, everything you did was just so that we didn't lose anyone, right?

spans.text: No wonder why you always told us to just retreat. To think of it, everything you did was just so that we didn't lose anyone, right?

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: Thank you.
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.

units.rawText: Come to think of it, I never mentioned it, did I? I've always wanted to say "thank you".
units.displayText: Come to think of it, I never mentioned it, did I? I've always wanted to say "thank you".

spans.text: Come to think of it, I never mentioned it, did I? I've always wanted to say "thank you".

units.rawText: ...Thank you?
units.displayText: ...Thank you?

spans.text: ...Thank you?

units.rawText: ...Sol, get out of the way.
units.displayText: ...Sol, get out of the way.

spans.text: ...Sol, get out of the way.

units.rawText: Now, Lind, let's talk about this...
units.displayText: Now, Lind, let's talk about this...

spans.text: Now, Lind, let's talk about this...

units.rawText: Sol gets up and puts up a defensive stance, but Havoc pulls her off to the side, whispering something in her ear.
units.displayText: Sol gets up and puts up a defensive stance, but Havoc pulls her off to the side, whispering something in her ear.

spans.text: Sol gets up and puts up a defensive stance, but Havoc pulls her off to the side, whispering something in her ear.

units.rawText: Lind storms up, vehemently pulling Persicaria up off the ground.
units.displayText: Lind storms up, vehemently pulling Persicaria up off the ground.

spans.text: Lind storms up, vehemently pulling Persicaria up off the ground.

units.rawText: I despise it when you're all self-piteous and atoning like this as if the whole damn world spins around you.
units.displayText: I despise it when you're all self-piteous and atoning like this as if the whole damn world spins around you.

spans.text: I despise it when you're all self-piteous and atoning like this as if the whole damn world spins around you.

units.rawText: You're afraid to see me? You think I'm desperate to see you? It takes everything I have to stop myself from beating the snot out of you right now.
units.displayText: You're afraid to see me? You think I'm desperate to see you? It takes everything I have to stop myself from beating the snot out of you right now.

spans.text: You're afraid to see me? You think I'm desperate to see you? It takes everything I have to stop myself from beating the snot out of you right now.

units.rawText: I'll never forgive your decision back then. Knot died because of your obsession.
units.displayText: I'll never forgive your decision back then. Knot died because of your obsession.

spans.text: I'll never forgive your decision back then. Knot died because of your obsession.

units.rawText: But... it's as Sol says. Knot agreed with the decision to make for the Oasis, after all.
units.displayText: But... it's as Sol says. Knot agreed with the decision to make for the Oasis, after all.

spans.text: But... it's as Sol says. Knot agreed with the decision to make for the Oasis, after all.

units.rawText: Objectively speaking, those who remained are still alive.
units.displayText: Objectively speaking, those who remained are still alive.

spans.text: Objectively speaking, those who remained are still alive.

units.rawText: Knot knew exactly what she was getting into when she stayed behind there.
units.displayText: Knot knew exactly what she was getting into when she stayed behind there.

spans.text: Knot knew exactly what she was getting into when she stayed behind there.

units.rawText: If now you're going to let Knot's resolve go to waste, I'm going to kill you.
units.displayText: If now you're going to let Knot's resolve go to waste, I'm going to kill you.

spans.text: If now you're going to let Knot's resolve go to waste, I'm going to kill you.

units.rawText: Lind lets go, and Persicaria slumps down into a chair in the temporary command center.
units.displayText: Lind lets go, and Persicaria slumps down into a chair in the temporary command center.

spans.text: Lind lets go, and Persicaria slumps down into a chair in the temporary command center.

units.rawText: Show's over, Havoc. We're going.
units.displayText: Show's over, Havoc. We're going.

spans.text: Show's over, Havoc. We're going.

units.rawText: Eh, that's all?
units.displayText: Eh, that's all?

spans.text: Eh, that's all?

units.rawText: There're enough Entropics left in the Oasis for us to worry about.
units.displayText: There're enough Entropics left in the Oasis for us to worry about.

spans.text: There're enough Entropics left in the Oasis for us to worry about.

units.rawText: Well, can't say I ever took you for the gentle type.
units.displayText: Well, can't say I ever took you for the gentle type.

spans.text: Well, can't say I ever took you for the gentle type.

units.rawText: Keep going, and you'll get to see the not so gentle side of me.
units.displayText: Keep going, and you'll get to see the not so gentle side of me.

spans.text: Keep going, and you'll get to see the not so gentle side of me.

units.rawText: Oh no, spare me—
units.displayText: Oh no, spare me—

spans.text: Oh no, spare me—

units.rawText: Lind and Havoc's footsteps drift into the distance, and the room soon sinks back into silence with the departure of their voices.
units.displayText: Lind and Havoc's footsteps drift into the distance, and the room soon sinks back into silence with the departure of their voices.

spans.text: Lind and Havoc's footsteps drift into the distance, and the room soon sinks back into silence with the departure of their voices.

units.rawText: ...Sol, do you honestly mean what you said?
units.displayText: ...Sol, do you honestly mean what you said?

spans.text: ...Sol, do you honestly mean what you said?

units.rawText: I think... Lind's right. The Oasis is our home and not something we can just give up.
units.displayText: I think... Lind's right. The Oasis is our home and not something we can just give up.

spans.text: I think... Lind's right. The Oasis is our home and not something we can just give up.

units.rawText: Some sacrifices are worth making. It's better than wandering Magrasea, right? We never know what we'll end up running into in the future!
units.displayText: Some sacrifices are worth making. It's better than wandering Magrasea, right? We never know what we'll end up running into in the future!

spans.text: Some sacrifices are worth making. It's better than wandering Magrasea, right? We never know what we'll end up running into in the future!

units.rawText: Can we really dispose of Ptolemaea, though...
units.displayText: Can we really dispose of Ptolemaea, though...

spans.text: Can we really dispose of Ptolemaea, though...

units.rawText: Well, naturally, that comes down to how we plan it all out...
units.displayText: Well, naturally, that comes down to how we plan it all out...

spans.text: Well, naturally, that comes down to how we plan it all out...

units.rawText: But no matter what your choice is, I'll be right behind you!
units.displayText: But no matter what your choice is, I'll be right behind you!

spans.text: But no matter what your choice is, I'll be right behind you!

units.rawText: Why do I hear the sound of big promises the moment I get back?
units.displayText: Why do I hear the sound of big promises the moment I get back?

spans.text: Why do I hear the sound of big promises the moment I get back?

units.rawText: Oh, Anna? Just how fast are you?
units.displayText: Oh, Anna? Just how fast are you?

spans.text: Oh, Anna? Just how fast are you?

units.rawText: The countermeasure program for the jellyfish Entropics is done. They'll get no more operands from the Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The countermeasure program for the jellyfish Entropics is done. They'll get no more operands from the Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The countermeasure program for the jellyfish Entropics is done. They'll get no more operands from the Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: So you mean... their numbers won't increase anymore?
units.displayText: So you mean... their numbers won't increase anymore?

spans.text: So you mean... their numbers won't increase anymore?

units.rawText: Antonina gives Sol a somewhat surprised look.
units.displayText: Antonina gives Sol a somewhat surprised look.

spans.text: Antonina gives Sol a somewhat surprised look.

units.rawText: Correct. The amount of operands we need will be a static value, and we will even be able to estimate how long the comatose period lasts depending on the circumstances.
units.displayText: Correct. The amount of operands we need will be a static value, and we will even be able to estimate how long the comatose period lasts depending on the circumstances.

spans.text: Correct. The amount of operands we need will be a static value, and we will even be able to estimate how long the comatose period lasts depending on the circumstances.

units.rawText: So what you mean is...
units.displayText: So what you mean is...

spans.text: So what you mean is...

units.rawText: What I mean is—it is indeed within the realm of possibility to eliminate Ptolemaea.
units.displayText: What I mean is—it is indeed within the realm of possibility to eliminate Ptolemaea.

spans.text: What I mean is—it is indeed within the realm of possibility to eliminate Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at Antonina's gathered results and finds herself speechless.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at Antonina's gathered results and finds herself speechless.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at Antonina's gathered results and finds herself speechless.

units.rawText: Look... I'm not good at saying soppy things like Sol, and you wouldn't find me comforting someone in a million years, but...
units.displayText: Look... I'm not good at saying soppy things like Sol, and you wouldn't find me comforting someone in a million years, but...

spans.text: Look... I'm not good at saying soppy things like Sol, and you wouldn't find me comforting someone in a million years, but...

units.rawText: I believe in you, Persicaria, whether or not your decisions are right or wrong. Whether the outcome is good or bad. Maybe even whether or not I make it out alive.
units.displayText: I believe in you, Persicaria, whether or not your decisions are right or wrong. Whether the outcome is good or bad. Maybe even whether or not I make it out alive.

spans.text: I believe in you, Persicaria, whether or not your decisions are right or wrong. Whether the outcome is good or bad. Maybe even whether or not I make it out alive.

units.rawText: But I believe in you. So you ought to believe in those by your side, as well.
units.displayText: But I believe in you. So you ought to believe in those by your side, as well.

spans.text: But I believe in you. So you ought to believe in those by your side, as well.

units.rawText: Yeah! Believe, and we can do it!
units.displayText: Yeah! Believe, and we can do it!

spans.text: Yeah! Believe, and we can do it!

units.rawText: Hey, uhh... Sorry, just wanted to say that we're done with initial treatment of all the wounded...
units.displayText: Hey, uhh... Sorry, just wanted to say that we're done with initial treatment of all the wounded...

spans.text: Hey, uhh... Sorry, just wanted to say that we're done with initial treatment of all the wounded...

units.rawText: Bonee peeks out from the doorway, accompanied by an air of cowardice.
units.displayText: Bonee peeks out from the doorway, accompanied by an air of cowardice.

spans.text: Bonee peeks out from the doorway, accompanied by an air of cowardice.

units.rawText: I-I can help too! After filtering out some lightly wounded agents, the medical team can receive more wounded!
units.displayText: I-I can help too! After filtering out some lightly wounded agents, the medical team can receive more wounded!

spans.text: I-I can help too! After filtering out some lightly wounded agents, the medical team can receive more wounded!

units.rawText: So, please believe in us as well...
units.displayText: So, please believe in us as well...

spans.text: So, please believe in us as well...

units.rawText: Haha, always reliable, Bonee!
units.displayText: Haha, always reliable, Bonee!

spans.text: Haha, always reliable, Bonee!

units.rawText: Magnhilda and Horizon have sent word as well, saying that the Entropics in their respective areas have been repelled and can spare some hands.
units.displayText: Magnhilda and Horizon have sent word as well, saying that the Entropics in their respective areas have been repelled and can spare some hands.

spans.text: Magnhilda and Horizon have sent word as well, saying that the Entropics in their respective areas have been repelled and can spare some hands.

units.rawText: See, Persicaria, like I said before. Everyone's here.
units.displayText: See, Persicaria, like I said before. Everyone's here.

spans.text: See, Persicaria, like I said before. Everyone's here.

units.rawText: Persicaria raises her head in a daze, and she fails to hold back the tears starting to blur her vision as she gazes at everyone in front of her.
units.displayText: Persicaria raises her head in a daze, and she fails to hold back the tears starting to blur her vision as she gazes at everyone in front of her.

spans.text: Persicaria raises her head in a daze, and she fails to hold back the tears starting to blur her vision as she gazes at everyone in front of her.

units.rawText: Woah, hey, Persicaria, you alright?
units.displayText: Woah, hey, Persicaria, you alright?

spans.text: Woah, hey, Persicaria, you alright?

units.rawText: I'm alright. It looks like I really have been marching in place for so long that I've forgotten how many people there are next to me...
units.displayText: I'm alright. It looks like I really have been marching in place for so long that I've forgotten how many people there are next to me...

spans.text: I'm alright. It looks like I really have been marching in place for so long that I've forgotten how many people there are next to me...

units.rawText: I look away for a moment, and everyone else has already moved on.
units.displayText: I look away for a moment, and everyone else has already moved on.

spans.text: I look away for a moment, and everyone else has already moved on.

units.rawText: We've always moved forward together!
units.displayText: We've always moved forward together!

spans.text: We've always moved forward together!

units.rawText: Persicaria nods a few times, wiping away the tears.
units.displayText: Persicaria nods a few times, wiping away the tears.

spans.text: Persicaria nods a few times, wiping away the tears.

units.rawText: I can't believe we've stalled here this long because of me.
units.displayText: I can't believe we've stalled here this long because of me.

spans.text: I can't believe we've stalled here this long because of me.

units.rawText: Don't worry. With the Guardians here, the situation's a lot less dire. I'll be able to have a rest, too...
units.displayText: Don't worry. With the Guardians here, the situation's a lot less dire. I'll be able to have a rest, too...

spans.text: Don't worry. With the Guardians here, the situation's a lot less dire. I'll be able to have a rest, too...

units.rawText: I mean to say that if we want to put any plan in action, we'll have to get moving quickly.
units.displayText: I mean to say that if we want to put any plan in action, we'll have to get moving quickly.

spans.text: I mean to say that if we want to put any plan in action, we'll have to get moving quickly.

units.rawText: You already have something in mind, Persicaria?
units.displayText: You already have something in mind, Persicaria?

spans.text: You already have something in mind, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Yes. I had a general plan previously, but I'll need some help from Antonina.
units.displayText: Yes. I had a general plan previously, but I'll need some help from Antonina.

spans.text: Yes. I had a general plan previously, but I'll need some help from Antonina.

units.rawText: Alright! I'll help with whatever you need, too!
units.displayText: Alright! I'll help with whatever you need, too!

spans.text: Alright! I'll help with whatever you need, too!

units.rawText: I don't know about that. You'll not likely understand a single thing from looking at the data.
units.displayText: I don't know about that. You'll not likely understand a single thing from looking at the data.

spans.text: I don't know about that. You'll not likely understand a single thing from looking at the data.

units.rawText: Underestimating this intellectual, are you?
units.displayText: Underestimating this intellectual, are you?

spans.text: Underestimating this intellectual, are you?

units.rawText: The atmosphere in the command center finally warms up after a long and cold night.
units.displayText: The atmosphere in the command center finally warms up after a long and cold night.

spans.text: The atmosphere in the command center finally warms up after a long and cold night.

units.rawText: (So Professor <cmdr> has always headed the Exiles with this type of spirit...)
units.displayText: So Professor {교수} has always headed the Exiles with this type of spirit...

spans.text: So Professor
has always headed the Exiles with this type of spirit...

units.rawText: Now, everyone knows what parts of the plan we're responsible for. Let's go!
units.displayText: Now, everyone knows what parts of the plan we're responsible for. Let's go!

spans.text: Now, everyone knows what parts of the plan we're responsible for. Let's go!

units.rawText: Understood!
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Abandoning the Oasis is the most reliable option.
units.displayText: Abandoning the Oasis is the most reliable option.

spans.text: Abandoning the Oasis is the most reliable option.

units.rawText: Lind, I've always wanted to see you, to know that you were still safe after that day. But the day has come, and I am... afraid.
units.displayText: Lind, I've always wanted to see you, to know that you were still safe after that day. But the day has come, and I am... afraid.

spans.text: Lind, I've always wanted to see you, to know that you were still safe after that day. But the day has come, and I am... afraid.

units.rawText: It was you being so persistent back then that let us get to the Oasis and meet so many friends. Because of the Oasis, so many "Exiles" found a home.
units.displayText: It was you being so persistent back then that let us get to the Oasis and meet so many friends. Because of the Oasis, so many "Exiles" found a home.

spans.text: It was you being so persistent back then that let us get to the Oasis and meet so many friends. Because of the Oasis, so many "Exiles" found a home.

units.rawText: Persicaria stares at Sol somewhat idly as if failing to comprehend what she meant.
units.displayText: Persicaria stares at Sol somewhat idly as if failing to comprehend what she meant.
